propositions: The current CLI facade uses 19 overlapping frozensets and hand-maintained help resources, allowing parser/help drift and incomplete command registration.
Twenty-one intercept-only commands lack canonical help and behave inconsistently between `rebar help <command>` and handler-owned `--help`.
All command grammars must derive from a single side-effect-free stdlib argparse factory used by both runtime execution and build-time generation.
Generated package-help and overview bytes must be committed and authoritative for all help/unknown paths before operation, config, mount, or handler execution.
Exact command aliases must reuse canonical grammar/help, while compatibility spellings and hidden commands exhibit approved behavior without introducing docs-only parser authorities.
Runtime optional capability checks preserve degraded result shapes and occur after mode/backend selection, not during help or command discovery.
